svg.title: Sudoku in 12 passes
svg.desc: A hard Sudoku board solved by an independently trained MLX Next-Concept Modeling model in 12 passes. After pass 1 the grid is mostly wrong; after pass 12 it matches the solution.

g.text: Board 1 of the upstream hard test set, greedy
Each grid decodes the codes known after that pass;
boxed cells differ from the solution. One board
chosen by a fixed rule: fewest givens among boards
the model solves, ties by lowest index.
